# Amplitude — Startup Plan

Year one is the full Growth plan at 100% off, stated as a $60,000 value, with up to 100M events per month (~200k MTU) and unlimited teammates. Year two is 40% off the annual Plus plan.

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | free plan |
| **Maximum** | $60,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Volume limit stated as "200K monthly tracked users or 100M events/month". |
| **When it ends** | Sixty days before it ends we send a usage-based quote for year two, and you keep a standing startup discount off list price after that. |



> **Stacking:** Separate YC deal via Bookface; separate Tech for Black Founders track with different limits (<$30M raised, <150 employees, US-based).

### Notes

Eligibility is published in two places that agree: the comparison table ("Eligibility limit / $10M raised / 20 employees") and the FAQ ("<20 employees, <$10M raised"). Both are ceilings, not floors. A separate, more generous track exists: "Tech for Black Founders ... <$30M raised, <150 employees and US-based." A separate YC-specific deal is referenced ("We have a separate deal for YC folks - check out Bookface").
